text.body:
<1> oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ vmlvryūṁ karālinamahābhairavāya svāhā || oṃ hrūṁ phreṁ kici (2) mahāyoginirmalaṃ krodhavapukabhairavāya (2) || oṃ phreṁ kici (2) glūṁ mahāyoginī saṃghāya kili (2) kulagaṇeśvarāya svāhā || iti candra (ṁ) koṇe (* * *) ||
oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṃ (* * *) tāṅgaghāravrahmavatyai svāhā || oṃ phreṁ hāṁ kāṁ rurubhīmarudravatyai svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṁ cāṁ caṇḍakumāravatyai svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṁ kroṁ koṭacitravatyai svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṁ tāṁ unmattavyoṇavatyai svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṁ pāṁ kapālaśakravatyai svāhā || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṁ yāṁ bhīmacarcitabhayāyai svāhā || aiṁ hrīṁ phreṁ hāṁ śāṁ śaṃ hārakasaṃhāralakṣmī svāhā || iti vrahmānyādibhye aṣṭāhuti || iti yatrāṣṭake ||
oṃ āṁ phāṁ phīṁ sthitikālyai svāhā ||
<2a> śvarāyanandanātha īśvarīsaktisahitāya kkṣkkṣhskṣmlvryū siddhāntasarvādhikāra lvhsrauṁ aiṁ pādukāṃ pūjayāmi || śauṁ hsphreṁ śrīṁ hrīṁ aiṁ sarvādhikāra ājñā ājñā ājñā || aiṁ niraṃjanāya vidmahe nirākārāya dhīmahe tannoḥ śūkṣmā pracodayāt || thanā mūlamantra nadoya || mukhāgrayoḍhāvadoyajurāṃ || javalā hāthajevaṭa javalāsadoya || khavalāhāthakhavaḥ khalāsadoya || syaṃ yo svaṃ conugvatrā madhyasuduye || mūlamantraṇa || śivaduyesa paṃcadhārāyācchātu (2) hāyake || ghṛtāhutidaśavārayāye || prathamaṃ gāyatryāhune dhāra (25) || tritava ādine ūddhatvaṃ māṃsāhuti viye || kramastotrapaṭhet || tato dvārahomayā uhaye || oṃ hūṁ ūṁ kaṃkārayoraṇāya pūrvadvārāya oṃ hrāṁ hūṁ vāṃ mārakicinda hrūṁ phreṁ svāhā || <2b> oṃ rāṁ rīṁ rūṁ atriprākārāya āgnidvārāya svāhā || oṃ hrūṁ phreṁ kakāratāraṇāya uttaradvāradehatvaye kici (2) mṛtyuke kili (2) hūṁ phreṁ svāhā || oṃ yāṁ yīṁ yūṁ vāyuvyagandhaudaka prākārāya svāhā || oṃ hūṁ phreṁ kaṃkāratāraṇāpacchimadvārāya svāhā || oṃ kṣāṁ kṣīṁ kṣūṁ naiṛtya khaḍgaprākārāya svāhā || oṃ hūṁ phreṁ kaṁ kāratoraṇāya dakṣiṇadvārāya svāhā || oṃ phreṁ hūṁ kaṃkāratoraṇāya oṃ phreṁ hūṁ kālagrāsanī kaṃkārinyai svāhā || oṃ hūṁ phreṁ tṛṣākakārinya svāhā || oṃ hūṁ kṣudhākaṃkārinyai svāhā || iti daśadvāradravyāhuti || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ asmitāṅga aliganāśa bhairavāya svāhā ||
<3a> (* ?) rāpūjā vidhi || māṃsahutiyātaṃ || lākoṭathe (272) cchāgasiraṃ || lākoṭatrimadhunavāla śirasnāna alisnāna paṃcāmṛta snāna || hsuthusapaṃcaratnate || catasiṃdhraluṃ ceta jajomakā || hyāḍhupātanapāye || hyāḍhusvānamālate || thvanalinirīkṣaṇādi catusaṃskāra || mūlamantraṇajaparapavāra (27) || mūlamantraṇātridhā (3) || pūjā || ṣaḍaṅga || āvāhya || dhenuyoni mudrā || jajamānetoyāpayake || vākya || sahasreṇa carāyāṃti sthāgasyepi sitehute || trikāraṃ māsamakaṃ tu sahapraṃhunatetrayo || siddhatemāṃsahomena kṣaudrājyaṃ dadhi saṃyutaṃ || javakrīrārṇa homena sālitandurasyā sādhitaṃ || priyate tu śikhādevaḥ svacchandāghorarūpadhṛk || cchātamāṃsajvalanaghañca prīnutaṃ javapānute || kṣīrārnate bhavatsānti dadhipuṣṭi prajāyate || yajamānasyaṃ āvāmyalavahlāya || vākya ācāryamurtabhyo chāgasiramāṃsapātra tu pado hāyāmi || <3b> ācāryadakṣiṇā || paṃcadhārāktāya || vākya || marjharaṃ prācidhārāyāṃ vighnināsaphalapradā || pūrva || raktadharā tu yāmyāyāṃ vyādhināsaphalapradā || dakṣiṇe || kṣīraścayaścchimadhārāyāṃ āyuvṛddhi phalapradā || paścima || uttaresugandhavārāyāṃ lakṣmīvṛddhi phalapradā || uttaramadhye vīrapānadhārāyāṃ madhye saṃpisidhārakaṃ || paṃcadhārā prasiddhāni jajñakarmasusiddhati || madhye || thvate paṃcadhārāktāya || thanācchāgāḥ | rakāyāva || japarapa || aghoravajravatīsi (32) hakārādi hakārāntaṃ mūlenadhāra (27) || ājñamantraṇadhāra (7) || śrīṁ hrīṁ glūṁ slūṁ mlūṁ hrīṁ śrīṁ ratneśvarī śrīpādukāṃ pūjayāmi namaḥ || thvaratneśvarī navākṣaragajaparapadhrā (9) || aiṁ mlauṁ hlauṁ mlauṁ śrīmahānirvāṇeti sā kṛtidhālasva (3) ||
<4a> ghṛtāhudhārā viyajurā || vaṃśāpāṭanaviye || thāyayā anukramaṇamālakva || ghṛtāhuti goḍhavilaṃ oṭhatilāhutiviye || gotrasādi āhutivisyaṃ yajñe 'vanestaṃ āhuti jukodhu āśodhana || pūrṇāyātaṃ devī sa mūlamantraṇadhāra (108) || pāṭaśulinapūrṇāvākya || indrādyālokapālā grahagatāsakalā dvālavadīsamastā asmat yajñeṣurakṣe abhimataphaladādeva devī prasannā || nānāvighniprasānta mamaduritapadāmantramudrāvilāpaṃ etat sarvaṃ kṣanārtha prabhava tu bhavatāyajña saṃpūrṇameva || vākyanasaha || tilāhuti pūrṇāsumurtāstu svāhā || lājāpratiṣṭhā || iti tilāhuti purṇā || (* * * * * * * * * * * * *?) kārayet || tato mūlemantranavaruhāma || tato snāna maṇḍapaṃ kārayet || snānanidrā kalasasthāpayet || pūjaya || tato devadaśakriyā mārabhet || tato nyāhasana deva sādhayet || <4b> prāṇapratiṣṭhā jīvanyāsa || hutvā pūrṇā || yathā karma devārcanaṃ || āhutivispaṃthiyake || tilāhuti || svakarmakāmya viśeṣeṇachāgādi prokṣaṇamāsairdvikarṣaṃ pramāṇaiḥ khaḍgai trimadhu hetu mālāḍhye || cchāgaraktavali || dhvajādānavāya || tato pañcadhārāvāya || vaṃthugvatrasaṣāyu yāḍhu māku hāku cilu cāk | yathuse cchāgarakta || yauthusa dudu || yaṃthosagaṃdhodaka || dāthāsavīradhārā || thvakramaṇaṃ vāye || catasiṃdhra jajomat svāna || caphumaṃdhete || pujana || (5) lmlvryūṁ maṛladhārāyāṃ pādukāṃ (5) rmlvryūṁ raktadhārāyāṃ pādukāṃ || (5) vmlvryūṁ kṣirakarāyāṃ pādukāṃ || (5) ymlvryūṁ gaṃdhadhārāya pādukāṃ || (5) mmlvryūṁ vīradhārāyāṃ pādukāṃ || thvatepaṃcadhārāyamānasyaṃ lavahlācake ||
<5a> vākya || namāmi pāvakotejaṃ pavitraṃ sarvakarmasu || vaiśvānarī mahātejaṃ devi tuṃ sarva karmasu || svaryakarmāṇi śākhitvaṃ āryabhojanakārakaṃ agniyādisanārthāya trailokyahitakāmyayā || saṃpūjyateṣunityāni yajñakarmasadāni ca || ācāryāya namastubhyaṃ namaste śāntidāyakaṃ || dadhihomāpurāpustiḥ kṣīrahomenaśāntikaṃ || ṣanmāsantughṛtaṃ hutvā rogavyādhinināsanaṃ || rāyajuṣmāntile hotā āyuvṛddhijave hute || puṣṭiścaiva sadāhomaṃ triyuktaṃ taṇḍulaḥ priye || arkānāsahitavyādhi candrapalāsakāmadaṃ || kharjulaṃ artharābhāya apāmārgavahuputrakaṃ || sāmasamayate pāpaṃ saubhājñamadhudumvaraṃ || asvasthaṃ ca bhavet kāmaṃ durvā āyuścavardhanaṃ || kuśadharvadiśajīvapratyaḥ āyukāmyārthakaṃ || āyukāmyārthakaṃ || āyutrivaṃcakalyānaṃ putrapautradhanādhipaḥ || <5b> bhavatāguru prāsādena sarva kāryañcasiddhayet || vākyenasaha || ācāryāyamūrtabhyā havyapātraṃ upadohayāmi || yajamānasyaṃ ācārya homapātrahlāyavāśchādanahlāye mūlena mūlenajapasamrape (108) ṣaḍaṅgana pūjā || sirathidoye vākya || tvamagnerīśvaraṃ tejaṃ pāvanaṃ paramaṃ hṛdi || tasmā tatvadīyahṛtpadme saṃsthapyaṃ tarpayāmite || thvata atrīsake prārthanā ||
tato ghṛtāhuti kriyākaṃthanaṃ || visyaṃha || oṃ hrāṁ khphreṁ rāṁ vaiśvarāyajātavedalohitākṣaḥ ihāvaha sarva karmāṇi sādhayet svāhā || tilāhuti dhāra (3) || thvanaṃ ghṛtāhuti || agnistaṃ āhuti || tridevayogni || indādi (10) || hetukādi || prayāgādiḥ || aśitāṅgādiḥ || vrahmānyādiḥ || ṣaḍākini ca || catupīṭhā thvatastatoghṛtāhuti vinyaṃhe ||
<6a> oṃ hrāṁ phrāṁ rāṁ agnaye svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ khphreṁ raṁ vaiśvānarāya jātavedalohitākṣaḥ ihāvahasarvakarmāṇi sādhaya (2) svāhā || ghṛtāhutitridhā || agnistaṃ || tridevayogni || indrādi || hetukādi || prayāgādi || asitāṅgādi || vrahmānyādi || ṣaḍākini || catuṣpīṭha || thvatestaṃ ghṛtāhutidhāra (3) viyajurā || tato daśāpātanaviye suryastaṃ paśupatistaṃ caṃguyātaṃ vajrajotini caṇḍeśvarī bherujujatalavuṃgasagu kamalātīrtha ādinavapīṭhaḍhatayātaṃ dumāju ādina || thānayā anukramaviya || kalasayātaṃ || oṃ juṁ saḥ svāhā || dhāra (2) || gaṇagotrāsa || kumālibhujā || valiyātaṃ kṣetrana || paṃcavali || caturvadi || vrahmā || panita || agnikuṇḍaḍhocataṃduḥ || tridevādi || toāvāhyatejāavāya pātaṃ mālādhiye purṇayātaṃ āhuti || <6b> kalasamumantraṇadhāra (54) || purṇāvākya || śaktiprāṇavarāśranāhutavahā vrahmākṣabhūmimbhakā tejapuñjāsamākulo palakalāvālārkabhāśurā || māyāmakṣavipakṣarakṣakalitaṃ mūlaṃ vavidhvaṃsakā jātānaumi samastakāma jananīktiṃ ca prāsāstavīt || vākyanasaha || [kālāgniyajñaghṛtāhuti purṇāsumurtāstu svāhā] || [iti ghṛtāhutipūrṇāvidhi] || tato homapātraśuddhi || hūphaṭ || arghapātralaṃkhanasale || thvamantrajaṃ atrisapānadhāra (3) || cetalasvastikacoye || thvapātrasa || salikebhyaṃsthā akṣatahāmla dudu dhali ghelaḍokasti alisākhalavyālu siṃdhukāyuḍā || śirathikālācchihāyakaṃpuṣṭa aduvālasyā tu bhojapātaṃ lothvahā tridhā vrāhmaṇātāsanāya svāhā ||
<7a> oṃ hrāṁ hutavahāya svāhāya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ devamukhāya || oṃ hrāṁ saptārciṣe svāhā || iti jihvāhoma || oṃ hūṁ rāṁ cchaṁ daya hūṁ phaṭ svāhā || hūṁ phaṭ cchedaye || mantreṇa va jihvācchedayāyecchapujukolanakaṃ tayā bhāvanāyāya || oṃ hrāṁ phreṁ vahurūpāya svāhā || madhye sa ghṛtāhuti || ṣaḍaṅgana agnipūjāye || oṃ rāṁ hṛdayāya svāhā || oṃ rīṁ śirase svāhā || oṃ vaiṁ kavacāye svāhā || oṃ rauṁ netratrayāya svāhā || oṃ reṁ astrāya phaṭ svāhā || agnipūjā || agnikuṇḍayāmekhalāṃ sadigpālapūjayā || purvanisyaṃ || oṃ lāṁ indrāya namaḥ || oṃ rāṁ agne namaḥ || oṃ māṁ jamāya namaḥ || oṃ kṣāṁ naiṛtyāya namaḥ || oṃ vāṁ varuṇāya namaḥ || <7b> oṃ yāṁ vāyuve namaḥ || oṃ sāṁ kuvelāya namaḥ || oṃ hāṁ īśānāya namaḥ || oṃ aṁ anantāya namaḥ || oṃ oṃ vrahmaṇe namaḥ || itindrādigvali pūjā || oṃ hrūṁ iṁ śrīmahābhairavānnaye namaḥ || śaktihastāya namaḥ svāhā || madhyesaḥ || oṃ hrīṁ phreṁ vāṁ yāṁ rāṁ lāṁ dāṁ śāṁ mahākavacāya hūṁ kālāgnivakra (2) svāhā || oṃ yāṁ yīṁ yūṁ siddhiyognivaliṃ gṛhna (2) kālāgnirakṣa (2) svāhā || oṃ gāṁ gīṁ gūṁ geṁ glauṁ paṭhavitayavaliṃ hṛhna (2) kālāgniṃ rakṣa (2) svāhā || oṃ kṣāṁ kṣīṁ kṣūṁ kṣetrapālāyavaliṃ gṛhna (2) kālāgniṃ rakṣa (2) svāhā || iti mekhalāsavaliṃ pradāna || āsradhyānacandanādipuṣpai iṣṭayo triyāñjali ṣaḍaṅgavali āvāhyamudrāñcakāṃ kumāravārāgniṃ rakṣa (2) svāhā ||
<8a> oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ phreṁ vāgbhairavajātakarmāye svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || agnijātajurobhālape || dhyāna || krodhañcajātakarmāṇi carmānājātamāhutiṃ || jātāgnidhyāśvakurvanti jyotirūpaṃ vicintayet || śruvakṣamālanīdake vāmeśakti kamaṇḍaluṃ || meṣārūḍhaṃ jayeddevaṃ santajihvānamāmyahaṃ || nīlotpaladalākālaṃ kālāgniñcahutāsanaṃ || jyotirūpaṃ paraṃ dhyātvā samastaṃ śāntidāyakaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ phreṁ vāgbhairavīṣaṣṭhī karmāya svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || sithāra || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hphreṁ phreṁ kāṃjapabhairavakālāgnitamasi || ghṛtāhuti || nāmekarṇa || thanacaruthuya || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ phreṁ annaprāsanāye svāhā || āhuti || annaṃ prāsana || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ phreṁ yajamānāgnicuḍākaraṇāya svāhā || <8b> ghṛtāhuti || cūḍākarṇa || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ phreṁ jayabhairakālāgnigaṃ yatrāṃ pradānāya svāhā || oṃ staptārciṣāyavidmahe lohitākṣāyadhīmahe tannovahni pracodayāt || gāyatrī pradānāyā svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || dīkṣāviye || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ hrūṁ phrūṁ jayavāgbhairavī śivaśaktivivāhāntāye svāhā || ghṛtāhuti | vivāhā || iti daśakriyā vidhi || tyāgatayālayate panitapātrasate || oṃ hrīṁ khphreṁ vāgeśvaryai namaḥ svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || oṃ vāgīśvarāya namaḥ svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || oṃ hrāṁ sṛṣṭibhairavavisarjanaṃ || iti vāgeśvarī visarjanaṃ || tato saptajihvāhoma || oṃ hrāṁ agnaya svāhā || indrāyaisvānarāya svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ jātadale svāhā || oṃ hrāṁ hrūṁ hraṁ astrāya phaṭ ||
<9a> kuśanagāre || oṃ hrāṁ triśikhāyai vaṣaṭ || dhavakasaghelate || oṃ hrāṁ mahaṃtārikāyai vauṣaṭ tāpayāmi || vāyuvyakoṇasagherakaṃnake || gāyatrī na || oṃ hrāṁ hūṁ mabhākavacāya hūṁ drāvayāmi || kuśanavārāvathvakuśakuṃḍasacchoyakā vagharasaṃte || oṃ hrāṁ hūṁ hāṁ khphreṁ mahācaṇḍayogeśvarīpāya || vārajajaparape || dhenuyonimudrā kena || oṃ phreṁ hūṁ hūṁ hūṁ || mūlamantreṇatridhā japase || kuśagraṃthinagulidhavakasane ghṛtatribhāgathejurā || dakṣiṇa netra || oṃ hrāṁ agnaye svāhā || vāmanetra || oṃ hrāṁ somāya svāhā || tṛtīyanetra || oṃ hrāṁ agnisomābhyāṃ svāhā ghṛtabhātayā || kuśatanticatuvānakāyāva īśānakoyasaduya || mantra || oṃ hrāṁ agnisṛṣṭikṛte svāhā || jajamānajāpayake || <9b> vākya || līnayatrodbhagavān jaya svāhā tatrapraśuyate || namāmi tadahaṃ liṅgaṃ vyaktimavyaktamāgataṃ yātā || āryamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarvapāṭhakanāśanaṃ || āryapāpaharaṃ hṛṣṭvā āryaṃ pāpaharaṃ paraṃ || āryañcasuragaṇāmārya sarvamāryapratiṣṭhitaṃ || oṃ hrāṁ phrāṁ huṁ ghṛtemukhāvalokanaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāda || khālaloyayāmantrā || thvateghṛtesaṃskārajuro || tato ghṛtā huti || oṃ rāṁ vahnimurtaye svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || oṃ hrāṁ tu svāhā || (2) || tuva (2) || bhurbhuva (2) || tupataya (2) || vāhanāya (2) || jātavedaśe (2) || kālāya (2) || kālānārāya (2) || śruṃvāsalalāte || pūjana || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ khphreṁ vāgbhairavagarbhādhānāya svāhā || thvataighṛtāhuṃkāraya || arghādakenahāya || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ phreṁ vāgbhairavīyaṃ savarṇāya svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || puṃsavana || oṃ hrāṁ hrīṁ phreṁ vāgbhairavāsamantānayanāya svāhā || ghṛtāhuti || sīmantānayana jvālālyākhaḥ ||
